easy.text: Matter in the inner disk is heated to millions of degrees, generating the observed X-rays.

medium.title: Cygnus X-1
medium.line: X-ray binary in Cygnus containing a stellar black hole

medium.text: Cygnus X-1 is a galactic X-ray source in the constellation Cygnus and was the first such source widely accepted to be a black hole.
Hawking conceded the bet in 1990 after observational data had strengthened the case that there was indeed a black hole in the system.
